name: unIIcode
description: ML-generated characters for scripts that don't exist, then 3D printed into physical artifacts.

text: Unicode is the text encoding standard used by most modern computers, supporting 161 scripts and the world's major writing systems.
The encoding contains intentional gaps between scripts, with each new script starting from a round number. This allows characters to be added to existing scripts without disrupting others.
This project trained an ML model to generate entirely new characters to fill those gaps. Characters that don't exist in any language.
This character exists in no language. It was imagined entirely by the model.
Training data was prepared by rendering all characters as 128 by 128 pixel PNGs.
The Tamil script was then used to generate additional Tamil characters, extending the alphabet with forms that feel native but are entirely synthetic.
The generated characters were then 3D modeled and printed, turning imaginary language into physical artifacts.
